content.title: Interface-aware dynamic mode decomposition with control for partitioned multiphysics systems
content.abstract: We develop an interface-aware dynamic mode decomposition with control (DMDc) formulation for multiphysics systems, within an optimization-based partitioned coupling framework. The finite-element interface-input operator is projected onto the reduced space and kept fixed during identification, while the unknown state-dependent local dynamics are learned from trajectory data. The common interface control is recomputed online by minimizing the mismatch between the reconstructed physical interface quantities. The formulation accommodates local subproblems governed by ordinary differential equation
